scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.setup: docker compose up -d postgres && sleep 2 && pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run seed
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:time: for tz in UTC America/New_York Asia/Tokyo; do echo "== machine timezone: $tz"; TZ=$tz pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx --test ../artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-time.test.ts ../artifacts/portal/src/lib/time.test.ts ../artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-metrics-calc.test.ts || exit 1; done
scripts.test: pnpm run test:time && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx --test ../artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-crypto.test.ts ../artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-config.test.ts ../artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-rate-limit.test.ts
